pages.title: Navigating the Map
pages.content: Drag all around the screen to view where you are relative to fellow Laurie’s Love users to grow your circle!

pages.title: Understanding the Options
pages.content: There are 4 options you have when viewing the map and they are as follows

pages.title: All Members
pages.content: Switch between the interactive map view and a list with additional actions such as viewing their profile

pages.title: Filter by Member
pages.content: Slides in a screen where you can filter your selection to narrow down to specific information you know

pages.title: My Location
pages.content: Focuses on your current location with the same dragging functionality as the normal map view screen

pages.title: Map Info
pages.content: Slides in a screen where you can view additional information about the map and the benefits and reasons behind this feature from Laurie’s Love

pages.title: Adding Friends
pages.content: Whenever you navigate to a user's profile, you will be able to take several actions; one of them being to add a friend which will enable you view more information about them!

pages.title: Adding Friends
pages.content: Whenever you navigate to a user's profile, you will be able to take several actions; another one being to Send a Message where  you can start a conversation with them!

pages.title: Donate Screen
pages.content: When viewing the donate screen, you are given the option to donate a preset amount or a specific amount, but also you can change the occurrence with this handy switch

pages.title: Donation Details
pages.content: When you select the amount you would like to donate you will be brought to the screen where you can input manual payment details or proceed with Google Pay or Apple Pay

pages.title: Behind Donate
pages.content: On the top of the donate page if you click “Read More” a screen will slide up with a brief history on Laurie’s Love's mission
